name: La Palma del Condado (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red at the lower hoist and white at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Palma del Condado (a palm tree between arrows on white).
history: The flag of La Palma del Condado was approved by the municipal council on 25 April 1988; it is divided diagonally, the first part red and the second white. The town council has validated its documents with its arms since 1 February 1872.

features.role: La Palma del Condado arms — palm tree between arrows on white
